cards.title: Lambda Z Estimation Methodology (Best Fit)
cards.claim: Phoenix's 'Best Fit' method automatically determines points for Lambda Z calculation by performing linear regressions of ln(concentration) vs time on subsets of data points (starting from the last 3 non-zero points post-Cmax). It selects the regression with the largest adjusted R². If adjusted R² values are within 0.0001, the regression with more points is chosen. Lambda Z is defined as the negative of the estimated slope and must be positive.
conditions: Points prior to Cmax or end of infusion are excluded unless specifically requested.
Minimum of 3 data points required for automatic selection.
Slope must be negative for Lambda Z to be valid.
limitations: Cannot estimate if fewer than 3 positive concentration values exist after Cmax (non-bolus) or 2 (bolus).
Fails if slope is not negative.
Fails if time difference between first and last points in range is < 1e-10.
cards.downstream_use: Determines whether terminal half-life and extrapolated AUC can be calculated. Failure to estimate Lambda Z limits PK parameters to those independent of terminal slope (e.g., AUClast, Cmax).

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
